en: A sepia-toned photograph showing a group of children in ancient-style costumes posing in a choreographed stance inside an ancient stone theater. The stepped stone seating of the theater is clearly visible in the background. The children wear light-colored tunics with wide sleeves and dark wigs or headpieces, evoking ancient Greek attire. In the lower right corner there is a printed website address, and in the lower left a circular archival stamp or logo.
